name.title: Name
name.description: Job name. It identifies the audit in charts and run history, so renaming starts a separate history.

url.title: URL
url.description: Page to audit, as an absolute http:// or https:// URL without a username or password.

save_report.title: Save HTML report
save_report.description: Save the full Lighthouse HTML report of each audit. Reports can contain sensitive URLs and page content.

update_every.title: Update every
update_every.description: How often to refresh the charts from the latest result, in seconds. Refreshing never starts a browser.

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Time limit for one audit, in seconds. Time spent waiting for a free browser does not count.

check_every.title: Check every
check_every.description: How often to audit the page, in seconds.

vnode.ui:help: Charts of this job appear under the Virtual Node instead of this host. Define a static Virtual Node through `dem:vnode` or a YAML file in `vnodes/` under the Netdata configuration directory, then enter its reference name here. Leave empty to use the collecting Agent.
